answer: In an AI-agent economy, Sybil resistance arises when each agent must bond a unique shard of scarce physical resources such as refined shale as collateral, which is then recorded as a mirror entry on a public ledger of commitments. Creating fake identities forces the attacker to acquire and lock real shale assets whose value is tracked against a long-term economic horizon, imposing a capital cost that scales linearly with sybil count and cannot be forged or reused cheaply.
